name: whisper_voice_build_rules
description: Rules for building and verifying the WhisperVoice WPF application

dependency_check: Ensure native binaries (whisper.dll, ggml-base.dll, ggml-vulkan.dll) are correctly copied to the Output directory during target build.
Do not update .NET runtime version unless explicitly requested by the user.
verification: Check that newly introduced ViewModels implement INotifyPropertyChanged via standard patterns.
Verify that asynchronous hotkey hooks do not block the main WPF UI thread.
MANDATORY: Run 'dotnet test' after every change to a service contract, interface, or state machine.
MANDATORY: When modifying any class in WhisperVoice/Services/, update or add regression tests in WhisperVoice.Tests/ before marking the task complete.
MANDATORY: When adding or removing constructor parameters (DI contract change), verify all test fixtures reflect the updated signature.

testing_discipline.rule: No service contract mutation is complete without a corresponding test update.
testing_discipline.pre_commit_hook: See ARCHITECTURE_WIKI.md Section 4.2 for the bash/PowerShell pre-commit gate script.
